prescriptions.title: Post-Procedure Antibiotic & Recovery Care Plan (DEMO)
prescriptions.rawInputText:
Rx:
1. Tab Pantocid (Pantoprazole) 40mg - 1 tab OD (AC) x 7 days
2. Tab Augmentin 625 (Amoxicillin + Clav) - 1 tab BD (PC) x 5 days
3. Tab Dolo 650 (Paracetamol) - 1 tab SOS / PRN for pain or fever (max 3/day)
Special Notes: Drink plenty of fluids. Complete full course of antibiotics. Avoid NSAIDs without consulting.

medicines.name: Pantoprazole (Pantocid)
medicines.frequencyExpanded: Take once every morning before eating.
medicines.instructions: Swallow whole with water 30–60 minutes before breakfast.

confidence.name: high
confidence.notes: Standard therapeutic anti-ulcer regimen.

commonUses: Protection of stomach from NSAID-induced ulcers
educationalInfo.howItWorksSimple: Shuts down the tiny proton pumps in the stomach lining that secrete hydrochloric acid, significantly lowering stomach acidity.
educationalInfo.administrationAdvice: Swallow whole with water 30–60 minutes before the first meal of the day (usually breakfast). Do not crush, chew, or split delayed-release tablets.

important: Low magnesium symptoms (muscle cramps, tremors) with long-term use
urgent: Severe persistent watery diarrhea (C. difficile concern)
Signs of severe skin reaction (blistering, peeling)

precautions: Do not crush or chew delayed-release tablets.
Long-term continuous use (over 1 year) should be monitored by a doctor for bone density and vitamin B12 levels.
educationalInfo.storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from light.
educationalInfo.missedDoseAdvice: Take before your next meal if remembered on the same day. Do not take two doses at once.

medicines.name: Amoxicillin & Potassium Clavulanate (Augmentin 625)
medicines.frequencyExpanded: Take two times a day, spaced by roughly 12 hours (morning and night) with food.
medicines.instructions: Take right after meals. Complete the entire 5-day course.

commonUses: Ear, nose, and throat bacterial infections
educationalInfo.howItWorksSimple: Stops bacterial growth by preventing bacteria from building protective cell walls.
educationalInfo.administrationAdvice: Take at evenly spaced intervals. Taking it at the start of a light meal helps minimize stomach irritation. Complete the entire prescribed course.

urgent: Severe allergic reaction (anaphylaxis): hives, breathing difficulty, swelling of lips/throat
Severe colitis (frequent bloody stools, high fever)

precautions: Never take if you have a known penicillin or beta-lactam allergy.
Always finish the entire course even if you feel completely better, to prevent bacterial resistance.
May reduce effectiveness of oral contraceptive pills.
educationalInfo.storage: Store tablets/capsules in a dry place. Reconstituted liquid suspensions must be refrigerated and discarded after 7–14 days.
educationalInfo.missedDoseAdvice: Take as soon as remembered. If close to next dose, skip the missed dose and resume normal schedule. Do not double up.

medicines.name: Paracetamol (Dolo 650)
medicines.frequencyExpanded: Take only when pain or fever is present, keeping at least 6 hours between doses.
medicines.instructions: Take with a glass of water. Do not exceed 4,000 mg across all medications daily.

commonUses: Mild to moderate headache, muscle aches, toothache
educationalInfo.howItWorksSimple: Works in the brain and central nervous system to block chemical messengers that signal pain and regulate body temperature.
educationalInfo.administrationAdvice: Can be taken with or without food. Do not exceed 4,000 mg (4 grams) in any 24-hour period across all medications.

urgent: Severe allergic reaction with facial swelling
Signs of liver stress: dark urine, yellowing of skin/eyes (jaundice), severe upper stomach pain

precautions: Avoid consuming alcoholic beverages while taking paracetamol.
Check all other cough, cold, and flu medicines to avoid taking duplicate paracetamol.
Inform your doctor if you have known liver or kidney conditions.
educationalInfo.storage: Store at room temperature (below 25°C / 77°F) away from direct sunlight and moisture.
educationalInfo.missedDoseAdvice: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as remembered unless it is almost time for your next scheduled dose. Never take double doses.

morning.instructions: Take 30–60 minutes before breakfast on an empty stomach.
Take immediately after morning meal with a full glass of water.

evening.instructions: Take 12 hours after the morning dose, after dinner.

asNeeded.instructions: Take every 6 hours ONLY if fever (>100°F) or significant post-operative pain occurs. Do not exceed 4 tablets in 24 hours.

safetyFindings.title: Complete Antibiotic Course Directive
safetyFindings.description: You have been prescribed Amoxicillin-Clavulanate for 5 days. It is critical to finish all doses even if you feel completely healthy.
safetyFindings.reason: Prematurely stopping antibiotics allows surviving bacteria to develop antibiotic resistance.
safetyFindings.actionRequired: Set daily reminders to complete all 5 days.

explainability.why: Prescription indicates a 5-day bacterial clearance protocol.
explainability.whatShouldYouDo: Do not stop taking Augmentin early unless directed by your physician due to an allergic reaction.

safetyFindings.title: Check Other Pain or Cold Medications for Paracetamol
safetyFindings.description: Dolo 650 contains Paracetamol. Many over-the-counter flu syrups, headache pills, and sinus tablets also contain paracetamol.
safetyFindings.reason: Combining paracetamol sources can cause unintentional liver stress.
safetyFindings.actionRequired: Check ingredient labels on any other over-the-counter medicine before taking.

explainability.why: Paracetamol is widely used in multiple combination brand medications.
explainability.whatShouldYouDo: Always tell your pharmacist you are already taking 650 mg paracetamol.

questionsForDoctor: अगर एंटीबायोटिक लेने से पेट में हल्का दर्द हो, तो मुझे क्या करना चाहिए?
अगर मेरा पेट बिल्कुल ठीक महसूस हो रहा है, तो क्या मुझे फिर भी Pantoprazole लेना जारी रखना चाहिए?
सुबह और शाम की Augmentin की खुराक के बीच मुझे कितने घंटों का अंतर रखना चाहिए?
मेरी रिकवरी की जांच के लिए अगली फॉलो-अप अपॉइंटमेंट कब है?
prescriptions.simplifiedSummary: आपकी सेहत के लिए यहाँ तीन दवाइयाँ हैं: Pantoprazole आपके पेट को सुरक्षित रखने के लिए नाश्ते से पहले लेनी है। Augmentin 625 एक एंटीबायोटिक है जिसे आपको 5 दिनों तक दिन में दो बार खाने के साथ लेना है। Dolo 650 (Paracetamol) केवल तभी लेनी है जब आपको बुखार हो या शरीर में दर्द महसूस हो।

confidence.name: high
confidence.notes: Standardized from OCR reading "Ampicillin" (Match: amoxicillin).

commonUses: Bacterial respiratory tract infections (sinusitis, bronchitis, pneumonia)
Ear, nose, and throat bacterial infections
Urinary tract, skin, and dental infections
educationalInfo.howItWorksSimple: Amoxicillin stops bacterial growth by preventing bacteria from building protective cell walls; Clavulanate protects amoxicillin from bacterial enzyme breakdown.
educationalInfo.administrationAdvice: Take at evenly spaced intervals. Taking it at the start of a meal or immediately after minimizes stomach irritation. Complete the entire prescribed course.

urgent: Severe allergic reaction (anaphylaxis): hives, breathing difficulty, swelling of lips/throat
Severe colitis (frequent bloody stools, high fever)

precautions: Never take if you have a known penicillin, amoxicillin, or beta-lactam allergy.
Always finish the entire course even if you feel completely better, to prevent bacterial resistance.
May reduce effectiveness of oral contraceptive pills.
educationalInfo.storage: Store tablets in a dry place. Reconstituted liquid suspensions must be refrigerated and discarded after 7–10 days.
educationalInfo.missedDoseAdvice: Take as soon as remembered. If close to next dose, skip the missed dose and resume normal schedule. Do not double up.

confidence.name: high
confidence.notes: Possible medicine candidates: Cefixime (cefolac), Cetirizine (okacet). Please verify with physical label.

educationalInfo.howItWorksSimple: Kills bacteria by breaking down bacterial cell wall synthesis.
educationalInfo.administrationAdvice: Take once or twice daily with food or water. Complete full course.

urgent: Severe allergic reaction with hives or difficulty breathing

precautions: Inform doctor if allergic to cephalosporin or penicillin antibiotics.
educationalInfo.missedDoseAdvice: Take as soon as remembered, spacing remaining doses evenly.

confidence.name: high

educationalInfo.howItWorksSimple: Inhibits bacterial protein synthesis by binding to the 30S ribosomal subunit.

precautions: Avoid calcium, iron, or antacid supplements within 2 hours of dose.
Contraindicated in pregnancy and young children.
educationalInfo.storage: Store below 25°C away from direct sunlight.
educationalInfo.missedDoseAdvice: Take as soon as remembered with full glass of water.

In medical prescriptions, the abbreviation **"bd"** (or sometimes written as "bid") stands for the Latin phrase *bis in die*, which means **"twice a day."**

When you see this on a medication label, it typically means the medicine should be taken two times within a 24-hour period. To keep the levels of the medicine consistent in the body, it is usually best to space these doses about 10 to 12 hours apart.

**Important Safety Note:** Please ensure you check the specific instructions for each medication on your prescription, as dosing schedules can vary based on the type of medicine. Always follow the exact frequency indicated by your doctor for each specific item.

If you are unsure about the best time of day to start these doses, here are two questions you can ask your pharmacist:

1. "Since this medication is to be taken twice a day, what are the best times to space the doses to ensure it is most effective?"
2. "Should this medication be taken with food or on an empty stomach to help with absorption or to prevent an upset stomach?"
